sections.heading: Do British citizens need a Bahrain visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Bahrain, but can apply online for an eVisa or get a visa on arrival.

sections.heading: Bahrain visa for other passport holders
sections.text: UK residents on other passports may need to apply in advance, depending on their nationality. Residents of other Gulf countries may also qualify for an eVisa.

sections.heading: Bahrain eVisa or visa on arrival?
sections.text: Applying online in advance gives you certainty before you fly. Business visitors may need a letter from the Bahraini company they're visiting.

sections.heading: Bahrain visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Bahrain visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. We check the current rules for your nationality, complete your application and keep you updated until it's approved. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Bahrain.

faqs.q: Do British citizens need a visa for Bahrain?
faqs.a: Yes, but you can apply online for an eVisa or get a visa on arrival.

faqs.q: How long does a Bahrain visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.

faqs.q: Can you apply for my Bahrain visa for me?
faqs.a: Yes. Use our online form: upload your passport and we fill in your details, then we complete and check the Bahrain visa application and submit it for you.
